GOVERN.title: Govern AI Risk Management
GOVERN.objective: To establish and maintain effective AI risk management.

controls.GOVERN 1: Organizational policies, processes, and procedures for mapping, measuring, and managing AI risks are established, implemented, and maintained.
controls.GOVERN 2: Roles and responsibilities for AI risk management are clearly defined, documented, and understood.
controls.GOVERN 3: AI risk management is integrated into organizational culture and decision making.
controls.GOVERN 4: Processes to monitor compliance with laws, regulations, and ethical norms are established.
controls.GOVERN 5: Resources are allocated for AI risk management activities.
controls.GOVERN 6: Processes for internal and external communication about AI risks are defined and implemented.
controls.GOVERN 7: The organization establishes mechanisms for accountability and transparency related to AI systems.

MAP.title: Map AI Systems and Risks
MAP.objective: To establish a clear understanding of AI systems, their context, impacts, and risks.

controls.MAP 1.1: Intended purposes, beneficial uses, context-specific laws, norms, and expectations are understood and documented.
controls.MAP 1.2: Interdisciplinary AI actors, competencies, and participation reflect diversity and expertise.
controls.MAP 1.3: The organization mission and relevant goals for AI technology are understood and documented.
controls.MAP 1.4: The business value or context of business use has been clearly defined or re-evaluated.
controls.MAP 1.5: Organizational risk tolerances are determined and documented.
controls.MAP 1.6: System requirements are elicited and socio-technical implications are considered.
controls.MAP 2.1: The specific tasks and methods used to implement the tasks the AI system will support are defined.
controls.MAP 2.2: Information about knowledge limits and human oversight of the AI system is documented.
controls.MAP 2.3: Scientific integrity and TEVV considerations are identified and documented.
controls.MAP 3.1: Potential benefits of intended AI system functionality and performance are examined and documented.
controls.MAP 3.2: Potential costs from expected or realized AI errors or functionality are examined and documented.
controls.MAP 3.3: Targeted application scope is specified and documented based on system capability and context.
controls.MAP 3.4: Processes for operator and practitioner proficiency are defined, assessed, and documented.
controls.MAP 3.5: Processes for human oversight are defined, assessed, and documented.
controls.MAP 4.1: Approaches for mapping AI technology and legal risks of components, including third-party data or software, are documented.
controls.MAP 4.2: Internal risk controls for components of the AI system, including third-party AI technologies, are identified and documented.
controls.MAP 5.1: Likelihood and magnitude of each identified impact are documented.
controls.MAP 5.2: Practices and personnel for supporting regular engagement with relevant AI actors and feedback are in place.

MEASURE.title: Measure AI Risks and Performance
MEASURE.objective: To measure and evaluate AI risks, performance, and reliability.

controls.MEASURE 1.1: Approaches and metrics for measurement of AI risks are selected for implementation starting with the most significant risks.
controls.MEASURE 1.2: Appropriateness of AI metrics and effectiveness of existing controls are regularly assessed and updated.
controls.MEASURE 1.3: Independent assessors and relevant stakeholders are involved in regular assessments and updates as needed.
controls.MEASURE 2.1: Test sets, metrics, and details about the tools used during TEVV are documented.
controls.MEASURE 2.2: Evaluations involving human subjects meet applicable requirements and are representative of the relevant population.
controls.MEASURE 2.3: AI system performance or assurance criteria are measured and documented.
controls.MEASURE 2.4: The functionality and behavior of the AI system and its components are monitored when in production.
controls.MEASURE 2.5: The AI system to be deployed is demonstrated to be valid and reliable.
controls.MEASURE 2.6: The AI system is evaluated regularly for safety risks and demonstrated to be safe within risk tolerance.
controls.MEASURE 2.7: AI system security and resilience are evaluated and documented.
controls.MEASURE 2.8: Risks associated with transparency and accountability are examined and documented.
controls.MEASURE 2.9: The AI model is explained, validated, and documented, and output is interpreted within context.
controls.MEASURE 2.10: Privacy risk of the AI system is examined and documented.
controls.MEASURE 2.11: Fairness and bias are evaluated and results are documented.
controls.MEASURE 2.12: Environmental impact and sustainability are assessed and documented.
controls.MEASURE 2.13: Effectiveness of the TEVV metrics and processes are evaluated and documented.
controls.MEASURE 3.1: Approaches, personnel, and documentation are in place to regularly identify and track existing, unanticipated, and emergent risks.
controls.MEASURE 3.2: Risk tracking approaches are considered where AI risks are difficult to assess or metrics are not yet available.
controls.MEASURE 3.3: Feedback processes for end users and impacted communities are established and integrated into evaluation metrics.
controls.MEASURE 4.1: Measurement approaches are connected to deployment contexts and informed by domain experts and end users.
controls.MEASURE 4.2: Measurement results are informed by input from domain experts and relevant AI actors to validate intended performance.
controls.MEASURE 4.3: Measurable performance improvements or declines are identified and documented.

MANAGE.title: Manage AI Risks
MANAGE.objective: To treat and monitor AI risks effectively.

controls.MANAGE 1.1: Processes for prioritizing and responding to AI risks are established and aligned with organizational objectives.
controls.MANAGE 1.2: AI risk treatment plans are developed, implemented, and maintained.
controls.MANAGE 1.3: Plans for monitoring AI risks and for incident response and recovery are established.
controls.MANAGE 1.4: Processes for communicating AI risk information and decisions are established.
controls.MANAGE 1.5: Processes for updating, remediating, or removing AI systems when risk thresholds are exceeded are established.
controls.MANAGE 1.6: Processes for continual improvement of AI risk management are established.
controls.MANAGE 2.1: Risk treatment decisions are based on prioritized risks, impact analyses, and organizational risk tolerance.
controls.MANAGE 2.2: Controls and mitigation actions are selected and implemented to address identified risks.
controls.MANAGE 2.3: Residual risks are documented, communicated, and accepted by appropriate decision makers.
controls.MANAGE 2.4: Mechanisms for tracking the effectiveness of controls and for reassessing risks over time are implemented.
controls.MANAGE 2.5: Incident response and recovery processes are exercised and improved using lessons learned.
